Chapter 291: Chapter 3: Oh no, am I going to be surpassed by my disciple? (Please subscribe) – 2

Lin Yuan now made him demonstrate all the subsequent models in one go.

That was equivalent to—

a grade school student telling his teacher to bring out the middle school, high school, and university curriculums.

“No problem.”

The Chikun Star Lord nodded.

If it were any other disciple, the Chikun Star Lord would definitely have rebuked them for their arrogance and told them to focus on the task at hand before anything else.

...

But Lin Yuan…

Thinking of how quickly Lin Yuan had grasped the spatial model just now, the Chikun Star Lord felt it was best just to follow along and do as asked.

Hum…

One spatial model after another continuously condensed in front of the Chikun Star Lord.

Lin Yuan carefully observed each spatial model. Although he couldn’t grasp them instantly, having the Chikun Star Lord’s demonstrations meant that Lin Yuan’s future comprehension speed would definitely exceed his previous one.

About half a day later.

A satisfied expression appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

The Chikun Star Lord, on the other hand, stopped the demonstration of spatial models with a complex look on his face.

“Thank you, teacher. The disciple has now grasped the subsequent spatial models…”

Lin Yuan sincerely thanked him.

“Hmm…”

The Chikun Star Lord nodded.

In fact, during this half-day, he hadn’t spoken a word, just demonstrated various spatial models one by one.

He was completely acting like a tool.

Seeing Lin Yuan’s fully content expression, the Chikun Star Lord felt a sense of unreality.

Was teaching a disciple really this easy?

He was already adept at instructing disciples and knew full well that teaching them properly was a very strenuous task.

“Teacher, regarding the next seven thousand seven hundred eighty-two spatial models…”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment, planning to fully utilize this opportunity of being instructed.

The nine hundred sixty-five spatial models that Lin Yuan had currently comprehended were just scratching the surface essence of the space rules.

Understanding these nine hundred sixty-five spatial models meant just entering the space rules.

But beyond the beginner level, one still needed to comprehend more of the space’s essential rules.

Therefore, after the nine hundred sixty-five spatial models, there were still seven thousand seven hundred eighty-two spatial models.

“The subsequent models, it’s hard for outsiders to instruct, and one must rely on self-comprehension…”

The Chikun Star Lord spoke evenly, feeling extremely helpless inside.

Even he hadn’t fully comprehended the seven thousand seven hundred eighty-two spatial models, and the Chikun Star Lord vaguely felt drained by Lin Yuan.

Besides,

even if he had comprehended those seven thousand seven hundred eighty-two spatial models, he would not be able to demonstrate.

When it came to space rules, the superficial essence could be shown, but the deeper rule essences… even for the same spatial model.

The focus differed for different evolvers who had comprehended it.

“Okay.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

He was becoming somewhat impatient. As space rules were foundational laws of the main world, vast and endless, the aspects of space rules comprehended by others might not necessarily suit Lin Yuan.

“If you truly want to comprehend the complete space rules, you could visit the Battlefields of Different Races.”

The Chikun Star Lord suggested.

“Battlefields of Different Races?”

Lin Yuan was aware of such places, where the Human Race engaged in combat with deep-space other species.

“In the Battlefields of Different Races, numerous strong ones fight, and even Supreme Beings intervene, rendering the space unstable, and there even exist Permanent Spatial Rifts.”

The Chikun Star Lord spoke with a sigh.

“Supreme Beings?”

Lin Yuan’s expression grew solemn.

Within the Cosmic Human Alliance, there were nine Supreme Beings. Each Supreme Being guarded one Evolution Tower, illuminating the timeless cosmic starry skies.

Even across the vast cosmic starry skies, Supreme Beings were the ceiling of combat power, unparalleled.

Only conflicts between Supreme Beings could create permanent spatial rifts, otherwise, given the ‘self-healing ability’ of the main world universe starry sky, even large spatial rifts would gradually ‘heal.’

Over more than two million years of the Starry Sea Era, human civilization had expanded rapidly, severely beating different species, primarily because of the numerical superiority of Supreme Beings.

Even the Peak Clans like the war machine Insect Race, with only six Supreme Beings, held the advantage on middle and lower tier battlefields.

However, they found themselves at a disadvantage when it came to clashes between Supreme Beings.

“Our universe, where we reside, has stable spaces and subdued rule fluctuations, which makes comprehending space rules very difficult.”

“However, in the Battlefields of Different Races, space isn’t that stable, especially those that are torn with Permanent Spatial Rifts, where endless space powers permeate, which is quite beneficial for comprehending space rules.”

Chikun Star Lord said.

The Battlefields of Different Races are like a meat grinder for countless clans of the universe, filled with dangers, but also numerous opportunities.

It’s easier to sense the Space Rules, but that’s just one aspect.

There are others.

For example, certain heritages, many treasures.

Many strong ones of Different Species fight to the death, leaving treasures scattered in hidden locations, their corpses even buried underground.

The corpses of the strong ones from Different Species also hold great value.

Furthermore.

The Permanent Spatial Rifts on the Battlefield of Different Species sometimes welcome “guests from beyond the realm.”

If you can seize the opportunity, you can gain quite a few benefits.

“However, if you, my disciple, wish to go to the Battlefield of Different Species, you must not go in person; send an avatar there instead.”

Chikun Star Lord instructed.

For a talent like Lin Yuan, going in person to the Battlefield of Different Species is like a feast for those Different Species.

If Lin Yuan hides within human territories, within Chikun Main Star—

If the Different Species want to assassinate Lin Yuan, they would have to pay a huge price, and afterwards, Lin Yuan would be resurrected.

But on the Battlefield of Different Species? The moment the information of Lin Yuan appearing there is leaked, believe it or not, there will be a bunch of Seventh Rank, Eighth Rank strong ones from Different Species lying in wait.

After all, on the battlefield, killing Lin Yuan would not require any consequences, even if he were to be resurrected later, it wouldn’t matter.

“I understand.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Even traveling to other worlds through the Door to the Myriad Realms, he did it through the ensured method of Consciousness Descent.

Not to mention going to the perilous Battlefield of Different Species.

“There are over ten Doppelganger Skills in the treasury, you can choose one when the time comes,”

“You are now Sixth Rank, and can withstand the soul division involved in creating an avatar.”

Chikun Star Lord said.

In the Main World, crafting an avatar involves much less cost than in the Immortal Tao World.

Still, it requires a portion of the soul’s power to be split and infused into the avatar.

Without a soul, an avatar is no different from a puppet.

Just splitting a part of the soul… those below the Sixth Rank of Evolvers simply cannot do it, and even if they could, it would result in a great loss of Origin Source and potential.

“My Martial Tao Primordial Spirit, Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit…”

Lin Yuan subconsciously compared his Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit with the traditional avatar techniques of the Main World.

In the end, he concluded.

The Martial Tao Primordial Spirit should be superior to most avatar techniques.

At the very least, it does not require Lin Yuan to actively split his soul; Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit share one consciousness with Lin Yuan’s true self, a trinity.

“It’s said that deep in the Cosmic Starry Skies, some rare special life forms naturally possess the ‘Doppelganger’ Talent. Most of the Avatar Techniques of human civilization are derived from those naturally gifted with ‘Doppelganger’…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Those ‘Doppelganger’ Talents were indeed similar to his Martial Tao Primordial Spirit, sharing consciousness without the need for soul splitting.

…

Next.

Chikun Star Lord gave Lin Yuan a few more words of advice.

Essentially, even if you craft an avatar to go to the Battlefield of Different Species, it’s best not to reveal your identity.

And don’t try to kill those from Different Species; there’s no need. If the avatar were to fall on the battlefield, it would also affect Lin Yuan’s true body.

The crimson palace.

Chikun Star Lord watched Lin Yuan leave.

“In terms of understanding Space Rules, except for the eldest disciple, no one else should be able to surpass him now, should they?”

Chikun Star Lord quietly thought to himself.

Having grasped over eight hundred kinds of spatial models, only his eldest disciple could barely outdo him, as for the second and third disciples, they were at best on par or even slightly weaker.

The later disciples such as the fourth and fifth, not to mention, weren’t even Seventh Rank.

“This talent…”

Chikun Star Lord sighed.

In Lin Yuan, Chikun Star Lord felt as though he had grown old, unable to keep up with the times.

In such a short period of time, Lin Yuan had grown from initially being the weakest among the thirteen Peak Masters at Fourth Rank, to now being second only to the Great Peak Master.

Chikun Star Lord could foresee that, given Lin Yuan’s current speed of cultivation and enlightenment, surpassing the Great Peak Master was only a matter of time.

Not right…

Chikun Star Lord suddenly tensed in his heart.

Damn, he wouldn’t also be surpassed by his own disciple, would he?
